brand_dna.category: Affordable stylish wristwatches and jewelry for men, women, and kids, sold direct-to-consumer with a give-back mission.
brand_dna.core_belief: BE GOOD, DO GOOD - Arvo donates a portion of sales to good causes in its effort to be socially responsible and better the lives of those it can.
proof_points: Limited 1-year warranty on defects in materials and craftsmanship
Custom engraving available and does NOT void the warranty
Donates a portion of sales to good causes via Arvo Gives
brand_dna.positioning: Accessible, value-priced watches ($79.95-$99.95) with a feel-good, socially responsible angle - not luxury, not throwaway fashion.

banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim with no verifiable backing on site
